newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil and France mull joint satellite launchers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil and France mull joint satellite launchers.

text.p: France and Brazil are discussing setting up a joint venture to build launch vehicles for satellites, a senior Brazilian Foreign Ministry official said.

Marcelo Jardim, director general of the Europe department, told reporters an agreement was being worked on and would be concluded "rapidly". The cooperation would be between the Brazilian space agency and the INPE research institute and French state-owned missiles to aircraft group Aerospatiale, a subsidiary of arms manufacturer Matra and the French Space Agency.
"Beyond satellite construction and being able to use bases in French Guyana and (in Brazil's northeast), we are also looking at building joint launching vehicles," Jardim said.
He said the deal was still embryonic and the details had to be worked out between the firms and agencies.
